Hello I had a first interview with Bloomberg and did not pass. I thought about the possible solutions but I cannot figure out what the optimal solution is. 

Design a module and insert a data looking like this.

```python
(id:1, timestamp: 1pm, tags: ["us", "uk", "japan"])
```

You want to query all the data by passing in a tag and timestamp.

```python
(tag: "us", start_time: "12pm", end_time: "2pm")
```

The module will read more than insert. Reading should be faster than inserting. What is the possible optimal solution that read is more optimized than insert? Thank you in advance

****Round 1: Technical + Written English + Gamified****

I recently participated in an On Campus drive at Capgemini, and while I was ultimately selected for a competitive package, the journey was anything but easy. In the first round, candidates face multiple sections within a single test, and progression depends on qualifying each section. The entire test lasts about 2 hours, so managing time effectively is crucial.

The technical section includes 25 MCQs focused on Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) and programming, followed by 15 questions that cover essential topics from cloud computing, operating systems (OS), and networking. Given the breadth of these topics, it’s vital to brush up on your fundamentals to stand a chance of qualifying.

Should you pass this technical section, you’ll then encounter the Written English test. In this part, you'll be required to write a 200-220 word paragraph on general topics like pollution or the effects of heatwaves on the public—this tests not only your writing skills but also your ability to articulate thoughts clearly under time constraints.

Once you clear the English test, the next hurdle is the Gamified round, which features various logical and memory games. Familiarizing yourself with similar exercises through YouTube resources can be beneficial, but the unpredictability of this section can throw many candidates off their game. After completing all the rounds, you’ll need to wait for the results. If you performed well, you can expect an invitation for the Coding round within 2-3 working days.

This round presents a set of coding challenges designed to test your algorithmic thinking and coding skills under pressure.
